title: TES IFR Program — User Manual

faq: The app looks old or a button is missing after an update.
Do a hard refresh: Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows/Linux, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac. On a phone, close and reopen the app. The app updates itself in the background; the new version shows on the next load.

Yes. After the first load, lessons, the library, quizzes and tools work offline. Narration audio downloads in the background after the first visit; until then a clip needs a connection the first time it plays.
How does School Cloud sync work?

Your work saves on the device first. When you are signed in and online, changes upload in the background and other members' updates download about every minute and when you return to the app. Offline changes wait in an outbox and send when you reconnect.
I signed in but don't see my school's data.
Check the School Cloud page: it shows your role, school and sync state. Make sure you joined with the right code. Students see their own records; CFIIs and admins see the school.
On this device (browser storage). Use the backup and restore option to move it to another device. With School Cloud, it is also stored in your school's cloud project.
Hard refresh once (Ctrl+Shift+R). Add ?perf to the address to show how long each tab takes to draw and tell your administrator the numbers.
Is the data in the demo real?
No. Demo data is marked SAMPLE and EXAMPLE and is removed with Reset.
Can I use this for navigation?
No. Practice plates and fields are fictional. Always use current official charts and the FAA/eCFR text.
